title: OpenAI releases new model architecture with sparse attention
description: OpenAI unveiled a new model architecture using sparse attention layers, claiming faster inference at similar quality to dense models.

title: Apache Iggy, a message streaming platform in Rust, graduates to an Apache TLP
description: Apache Iggy, a message streaming platform written in Rust, has graduated from incubation to a full Apache Top-Level Project.

title: Nvidia's $3.5B MediaTek bet reveals its plan for tackling Big Tech's AI chip buildout
description: Nvidia invests $3.5 billion into Taiwanese chipmaker MediaTek, aiming to stay essential to AI infrastructure as Big Tech builds its own chips.

title: Vijay Pande spins out a smaller AI-native biotech fund after leaving a16z
description: Vijay Pande, who ran a16z's roughly $4 billion biotech practice, has left to start a much smaller, AI-native venture fund called VZVC.

title: New study shows large language models exhibit emergent reasoning at scale
description: Researchers published a study arguing that certain reasoning capabilities in large language models only emerge past a specific parameter-count threshold.

title: Coordination Headwind: How Organizations Are Like Slime Molds
ChatGPT and Reddit now face EU's toughest online safety rules
description: Explosive growth comes with a new regulatory burden as the EU applies its strictest online safety rules to ChatGPT and Reddit.

title: Turns out Brits would quite like their private messages to stay private
description: Polling finds two-thirds of respondents don't trust the current or any future government with access to their encrypted messages.

title: Sony Music, Warner sue Anthropic, alleging a brazen campaign of intellectual property theft
description: Sony Music and Warner filed a broad lawsuit against Anthropic, accusing it of illegally using copyrighted song lyrics to train its models.
